title: Rejected await in try

choices.md: Rejects the async function (an exception in that function)

blocks.explainMd: The await throws into that async function. The function’s promise rejects unless you catch it.

blocks.promptMd: > `readKey()` must `await Promise.reject(...)` inside `try/catch` and return `e.message`. Do not hard-code `return "lost"`. Print it.

hintLadder.md: The desk stamp is the string `lost`. Export `readKey` and print it.

description: A rejected await belongs in try and catch, like a throw.
